works.name: KeyOSX
works.status_detail: In active build — this catalog module is the first operational piece.
works.tagline: The master living kiosk for every work Joe has built, is building, or is planning.
works.summary: KeyOSX is the searchable home for the complete published catalog: brands, platforms, engines, applications, books, documents, and concepts, each tracked with its relationships, timeline, and Old/Current/Future status.
works.body: KeyOSX does not replace any individual brand's own site or application — it is the index and guide that sits above all of them, so a visitor (or Joe) can ask what something is, whether it is still active, what replaced it, and where to actually go. Its technical foundation is a reused Node/Express/SQLite kiosk originally built for a single-location local-information use case; that local-guide content model belongs to Almanac, not to KeyOSX itself.

works.name: Jack Rabbit
works.status_detail: Live inside KeyOSX; deterministic by default.
works.tagline: KeyOSX's universal search-and-retrieval guide.
works.summary: Jack Rabbit searches the full published catalog, finds related works, explains status and history, and points to the correct active site, application, document, or future concept. It answers only from published catalog records and never invents a status, URL, or relationship.
works.body: An optional OpenAI-compatible connection can improve response wording, but Jack Rabbit works fully offline by default, grounded entirely in KeyOSX's own database.

works.name: ME•DÍA OS
works.status_detail: Naming locked as of spec v10 (July 2026) — do not reopen without a week of live instance data.
works.tagline: Made by people, powered by stories.
works.summary: The seven-layer AI-powered publishing and business operating system: Identity, Almanac, Website, Social, Digital Workforce, Commerce, CRM, and Community. One owned engine, deployed once per niche, with only the brand skin changing.
works.body: ME•DÍA is the parent, customer-facing brand — not a single website and not an AI wrapper. Almanac and FlintBill are internal engine terms under it, not customer-facing branding. Every current real-estate and lifestyle brand in this catalog (IREFS, GoCarcassonne, Basil Leaf Chronicles, Florida Renter's Guide, American Real Estate) is the same ME•DÍA OS wearing a different skin.

works.name: Almanac
works.status_detail: Live as a link-destination blog on Manus; the fuller library/store/education vision is direction, not yet built.
works.tagline: The continuously updating knowledge layer — living memory for every brand.
works.summary: Not a book, not hand-written articles: a self-updating library of rates, news, patterns, events, and resources that a brand's social posts always have somewhere to route back to, so the site never looks dead.
works.body: Three Almanac instances currently run side by side deliberately, as a live comparison of approaches — not three copies of one broken thing. None of the three is ME•DÍA itself. The prior single-location local-information kiosk implementation (locations, listings, businesses, events, news for one city or postal code) is Almanac's content model specifically, reused as KeyOSX's technical foundation but not KeyOSX's actual scope.

works.name: FlintBill
works.status_detail: Confirmed module of FlintAI/GAEM.OS by a July 2026 Codex file-evidence audit.
works.tagline: Internal logistics/routing layer — which AI does which job, how work moves through the system.
works.summary: A module mounted inside FlintAI at the /flintbill, /flintbill-v2, and /classic-flintbill routes. No standalone FlintBill project exists anywhere in the Replit account. Currently operates as a marketing/lead-gen mission engine, not the AI-tutor education loop originally imagined under this name.
works.body: This is one of two live threads carrying the FlintBill name — see the separate FlintBill Socratic Tutor concept for the education-focused direction that split off from the same origin idea.

works.name: Flint Bill (origin concept)
works.status_detail: Historical — superseded operationally by the FlintBill engine and, in direction, by FlintBill Socratic Tutor.
works.tagline: The founding manuscript and naming origin.
works.summary: Conceived while manually relaying Codex and Claude output back and forth to each other. Its core pitch — 'not generic, not stale by week's end' — is the thread that both later FlintBill directions trace back to.

works.name: FlintBill Socratic Tutor
works.status_detail: Design direction only — not yet built.
works.tagline: A bounded AI-as-inquisitor lesson that ends in a student-owned puzzle, game, or project.
works.summary: The education-focused branch of the original FlintBill idea. After a debate-one-topic model tested weak, the direction shifted toward a scoped Socratic dialogue with a concrete 'cadeau' at the end, rather than open debate or rabbit-hole exploration.
works.body: Distinct from the FlintBill engine that actually ships inside FlintAI today — same name origin, different live status. Being considered as a direction inside AI Masterclass rather than as its own product.

works.name: Max
works.status_detail: Designed in the ME•DÍA OS spec; the daily briefing and coordination prompt are still an open build item.
works.tagline: The Chief Operating Officer AI — starts the day instead of waiting to be asked.
works.summary: Max would open each morning with a proactive briefing balancing immediate, strategic, and foundational horizons, then ask 'Would you like me to coordinate the team?' Every other AI tool in the stack reports to Max; Max reports to Joe.

works.name: GAEM
works.status_detail: Live; consolidation across its sub-projects is not yet authorized.
works.tagline: The Power-of-5 strategic framework and umbrella for GAEM.OS, GAEM University, and related builds.
works.summary: GAEM is an umbrella ecosystem name, not one application. It groups the core FlintAI platform, the education arm, and several adjacent real-estate and commerce experiments that still need traffic, database, and API documentation before any of them are merged.

works.name: GAEM.OS (FlintAI)
works.status_detail: Live at app.gaem.pro and gaem.life.
works.tagline: The owned core platform.
works.summary: The confirmed canonical Replit codebase, publicly branded 'GAEM.OS v2.0 — Enterprise AI Platform.' Includes FlintBill as an internal module. Whether this name is synonymous with the platform earlier discussed as FlintBill/CityView/core Almanac services, or a separate project that happens to also live on Replit, is still unresolved.

works.name: GAEM University
works.status_detail: Live.
works.tagline: Human-AI collective intelligence education platform.
works.summary: Live alongside GAEM.OS at app.gaem.pro. Whether ME•DÍA is meant to be a front door into GAEM University, or a parallel education track, has not been resolved.

works.name: IREFS (Italian Real Estate For Sale)
works.status_detail: Live — first production instance; pre-sale polish in progress.
works.tagline: Italian real estate — the first production ME•DÍA OS instance.
works.summary: The proof case for the whole factory model: non-rebate content is live, the rebate mechanism awaits a legal basis, and its Pricing/Transfer/Flippa pages exist because the brand itself is built to be sold.

works.name: GoCarcassonne
works.status_detail: Live, Instagram launching.
works.tagline: Local Carcassonne tourism and lifestyle guide.
works.summary: One of the early ME•DÍA OS skins, sharing the Carcassonne region with Basil Leaf Chronicles and Carcassonne Concierge but scoped to tourism and lifestyle content rather than property operations.

works.name: Basil Leaf Chronicles
works.status_detail: Live, Instagram launching.
works.tagline: Food and lifestyle brand.
works.summary: A ME•DÍA OS skin focused on food and lifestyle content.

works.name: Carcassonne Concierge
works.status_detail: Stabilized — new domain and Hostinger rebuild done.
works.tagline: Property management and guest concierge operations for the Carcassonne region.
works.summary: Distinct from GoCarcassonne: this is the operational intake app (owner, traveler, service, and partnership workflows) plus its own public business site, deliberately kept separate from the future Automation Foundation backend and Opportunity Engine.
works.body: Public site: carcassonneconcierge.com. Operational app: app.carcassonneconcierge.com. Every submission gets a server-generated lead reference; the private ledger write is the acceptance gate itself.

works.name: Florida Renter's Guide
works.status_detail: Live, in rotation — rebate funnel active.
works.tagline: Florida rentals.
works.summary: A ME•DÍA OS skin with an active rebate funnel.

works.name: American Real Estate
works.status_detail: Live, in rotation — buyer rebate plus freebooks lead magnet.
works.tagline: US real estate and mortgage.
works.summary: A ME•DÍA OS skin combining a buyer rebate with a free-books lead magnet.

works.name: AI Masterclass
works.status_detail: Partially live — real-site launch in progress.
works.tagline: The flagship paid AI course.
works.summary: Built on a Day Pass / 10-Day Module / streak-reward / Pro-tier offer ladder. Pricing, guarantee, thank-you, and Day 1 pages are live; Days 2 through 10 and the delivery system are the next build phase.

works.name: Story Engine (PalmStory AI)
works.status_detail: In development.
works.tagline: A reusable upload → AI → report → PDF → white-label engine.
works.summary: A real SaaS product, not course content: a generic report-generation pipeline offered in Lite, Pro, and Business tiers, built to be reused across multiple brands rather than tied to any single one.

works.name: NoizeOS (Noize)
works.status_detail: Needs manual review — do not assume any status change.
works.tagline: A media/audio brand awaiting a consolidation decision.
works.summary: Flagged in the July 2026 Codex Replit audit as needing manual review before any decision about its codebase; traffic and ownership have not yet been documented.

works.name: Big Fish Social / E5
works.status_detail: Live as a reference module inside the GAEM ecosystem.
works.tagline: Social/mobile presentation and lead-capture module.
works.summary: Runs on the Grid Cosmos codebase (Drizzle/Postgres), preserved specifically as the E5 presentation and lead-capture reference; its contact form and visual assets are the pieces worth extracting for reuse.

works.name: CityViewNavigator (CityView)
works.status_detail: Needs traffic review before any archive decision — nothing is confirmed dormant on inference alone.
works.tagline: Local search, place, route, review, and referral app for the real-estate group.
works.summary: A Flask/Python, SQLAlchemy application roughly nine months old at the time of the July 2026 audit, predating the FlintBill merge into FlintAI. Its PayPal integration defaults to sandbox mode, so payment readiness can't be assumed without checking the live environment directly.

works.name: Three-Division Business Model
works.status_detail: Structural framing, applied piecemeal across current builds.
works.tagline: Book Maker / Course Maker / Marketing Maker.
works.summary: A structuring idea for decoupling the reusable LMS shell from AI Masterclass's specific content, so the shell can be sold on its own as a $99–$999+ template ladder.

works.name: Almanac 2.0
works.status_detail: Concept only — no spec written yet.
works.tagline: A next-generation Almanac concept earmarked for keyosx.com.
works.summary: Described informally as an 'AI virtual kiosk.' Sits behind the keyosx.com domain as a placeholder direction, distinct from KeyOSX itself, which is the catalog and search layer being built now.
